about: One case table for the three copies of the card rules (docs/RULES.md): server/game/rules.js (Jest: server/game/__tests__/legalityCases.test.js), client/src/rules/legality.js + overTrump.js (Vitest: client/src/rules/legalityCases.test.js, overTrump.test.js) and iOSClient CardLegality.swift + TrickRules (XCTest: LegalityCaseTableTests.swift, OverTrumpTests.swift). Add a row here, never to one copy's test.
Cards: rank then suit letter (s h d c, j for a joker): 'As', '10h', 'HIj', 'LOj'. A trump of 'LOj' or 'HIj' is a flipped joker: the no-trump hand, where only the jokers are trump.
legality: `hand` is the player's whole hand before the play, `lead` the trick's first card and its seat (null: this player leads), `legal` exactly the cards of `hand` the player may play.

tricks: `trick` in play order (seat:card); `winner` is the seat winning it so far (server determineWinner for a full trick); `overTrump` whether its LAST card is an over-trump (the owner's 2026-11-11 rule, CLAUDE.md Cross-client rules); `oldDetectorWrong` marks the rows the pre-2026-11-11 web and iOS detectors got wrong.
